caption: Prato della Valle, Padua
composition: Elliptical square with canal ring and statues · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the wet pavement at the square's edge, the view takes in the full elliptical canal ringing the grassy central island, its ring of pale statues standing evenly spaced around the green. The domed church and old rooftops of Padua fill the left background under a heavy overcast sky, with tall cypresses closing the right. At 07:15 the light is flat dawn grey, and the rain-slick stones mirror the clouds.
